structure: Part 2 read e2e/description-of-the-goods.fit.spec.js in full (362 lines, 13 tests in 4 describes), plus e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines) for the shared assertions and journey steps those tests call. The spec covers section 2 of the task list, 'Description of the goods'. Describe 'commodity details' (3 tests): cattle number of animals validation, two commodities and removing them, germinal quantity/packages/temperature. Describe 'total gross weight' (2 tests): the germinal-only weight page and its absence for live animals. Describe 'identification details' (6 tests): cattle per-animal identifiers saved one at a time, three species-specific identifier sets (horse, cat, pig) from one loop, poultry flock panel, germinal donor/dates/mark with errors. Describe 'additional details' (2 tests): cattle certification purpose and unweaned animals, poultry certification purpose only. Routes covered, under the /design-release-2.1 mount: /create-notification?category=germinal-products, /consignment-details, /what-are-you-importing, /consignment-gross-weight, /animal-identification-details, /additional-animal-details and /arrival-details as the onward page. Shared assertions used: expectHeading (first h1), expectErrorSummary ('There is a problem' title and exact linked messages in order), expectInlineError (.govuk-error-message), expectBackLink (.govuk-back-link href), saveAndContinue (button name=action value=continue). fixtures.js only records visited pages for the trace index, so it adds no product claims.

claims.statement: Number of animals values other than empty and 0 (such as decimals, negatives or text) and the live-animal number of packages validation are not tested.

Commodity searches used by the suite map to these species and codes: cattle 0102 Bos taurus, chicken 010511 Gallus domesticus, cat 01061900 Felis catus, horse 0101 Equus cabalus, cattle semen 05111000 Bos taurus.
